invariants.rationale: On all non-exceptional paths, the method returns a new HoodieJavaTable instance, so result should never be null.

invariants.expression: result instanceof HoodieJavaCopyOnWriteTable || result instanceof HoodieJavaMergeOnReadTable
invariants.rationale: The method returns either a HoodieJavaCopyOnWriteTable or HoodieJavaMergeOnReadTable depending on the table type.
Method only returns when the table type is COPY_ON_WRITE or MERGE_ON_READ.
If the table type is COPY_ON_WRITE, result is HoodieJavaCopyOnWriteTable, and vice versa.
If the table type is MERGE_ON_READ, result is HoodieJavaMergeOnReadTable, and vice versa.
